verdicts.decision_note: The client requests a mustard block-colour pareo with a black border, defining the artwork's implementation-relevant colour layout.
The client supplies a tentative mustard Pantone reference and accepts visual approximation pending production confirmation, changing the artwork's colour-calibration input.
First implementation claim: the freelancer reports developing both previously identified block-colour pareos and providing Slim and Full border-scale choices.
The client retains the 7 cm and 17 cm block-pareo border measurements, defining implementation-relevant artwork dimensions without leaving conflicting prior attributes.
First concrete failure: the client observes that Tela Mare 3 has the colour arrangement reversed instead of a black border with a mustard interior.
Post-failure implementation claim: the freelancer reports uploading the corrected file, with the immediately preceding exchange resolving it to the mustard pareo colour-layout error.
